model_fit_source: train partition ONLY (Phase G/H regime) -- see sentinelpay.inference.artifacts
phase_d_state_source: all five partitions (train, embargo_1, validation, embargo_2, holdout) -- unrestricted, matches Phase D's own non-target semantics
phase_f_state_source: train + validation + holdout ONLY -- matches Phase F's frozen target-history contract
phase_f_update_policy: resolution-only -- a transaction contributes to Phase F counters ONLY via update_resolved_labels, never at occurrence. IEEE-CIS has no real label_resolved_at field; this models resolution as happening at the moment update-resolved is invoked, not any true confirmation time.
holdout_usage_note: holdout labels are incorporated here ONLY as resolved historical state for this forward-looking inference system. Phase H's sealed evaluation (reports/eda/phase_h_results.json) is complete and was NOT rerun; this state was NOT used to select a model, scaler, feature, or threshold.
